tasks.title: Design system and UI kit: colors, typography, buttons, chips, bottom sheet, toast, status chips
Design PostgreSQL schema (users, roles, addresses, products, stock, orders, order_items, payments, deliveries, status events) with encrypted address and contact fields and account-deletion purge
Set up Node.js REST API skeleton, HTTPS, environment config, role-based auth middleware, and CI/deploy pipeline
Build user accounts API and screens: register, login with bcrypt, saved addresses, account deletion request
Build catalog API with search, category, price and occasion filters, and availability; seed sample data
Build Home and Catalog and Product Details screens (web React and React Native) with filter sheet, out-of-stock state, and add to cart
Implement cart, delivery date and address selection, Stripe payment intent, order creation, payment failure retry, and confirmation email
Build Cart and Checkout screens with Stripe card input, order summary, error banner, and confirmation modal
Build order status API and Firebase Cloud Messaging notifications with status updates visible to customers within 30 seconds (polling or push)
Build Order Tracking screen: ETA card, status timeline, Google Maps courier location, delivered banner
Build order history and reorder (current prices) API and screens, plus Profile and Orders tabs
Build admin API and console for product CRUD, stock and price updates, incoming orders, and courier assignment
Build courier delivery list with status updates and Mark delivered, notifying customer and closing the order
Design admin and courier console screens and order tracking and checkout flows (low-fidelity to hi-fi handoff)
Performance and QA pass: load test 200 concurrent users on catalog, DB indexes, usability test of 5-minute order flow, accessibility check, and release to staging

risks: Scope is large for a small team: three platforms (web, iOS, Android) plus admin and courier consoles; mitigate by sharing the API and component logic and shipping the customer flow first.
Stripe integration and payment failure handling (no order on failure, retries, webhooks) may take longer than estimated and block F2 and F3.
Real-time tracking within 30 seconds depends on FCM and Google Maps quotas and courier location accuracy; fall back to status polling if needed.
Privacy requirements (encryption at rest, 30-day deletion) could be missed if deferred; build them into the schema in T2.
Mobile app store review and API key or account setup (Stripe, Google Maps, FCM) can delay release; start early.
